quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
why: The judge's only stated ground for UNDERDETERMINED is the contested wording of the single verse Isaiah 7:14 (virgin versus young woman) and its application, which is the kind of single-verse ground K-S2 forbids.
